31
Iron rusts in the presence of oxygen and water.
Which statements about the rusting of iron are correct?
1
Anhydrous iron(II) oxide is produced when iron rusts.
2
Iron rusts more quickly when attached to a piece of zinc.
3
Coating the iron with plastic prevents the iron from rusting.
4
Iron loses electrons when it rusts.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
